products.description:
Deploy OneDrive for Business with sync, KFM, and governance done right

OneDrive is where users' files live — deployed carelessly it means data loss, uncontrolled sync, and sharing risk. This solution deploys and governs OneDrive for Business: client deployment and silent config, Known Folder Move (KFM), sync controls (allow/block, restricted domains), storage and retention, sharing alignment, and offboarding/data-retention on departure — so user data is protected, synced, and governed.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the OneDrive model: client deployment + silent sign-in, KFM, sync controls, storage/retention, sharing, and offboarding.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (SPO/OneDrive admin, client-deployment channel (Intune/GPO), storage/retention policy, stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — deploy + silently configure the client, enable KFM, set sync controls (allow/block, restricted domains), set storage + retention, align sharing, and define offboarding/data-retention — pilot-first, each policy named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (client deployed, KFM redirecting, sync controlled, offboarding works) plus Best Practices for OneDrive governance.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

User files protected, synced, and governed — OneDrive deployed silently, Known Folders redirected, sync controlled, offboarding handled — no more data loss on a lost laptop.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ODFBGOV-Configure.ps1 — tenant OneDrive sync-control + storage/retention/sharing config helper (dry-run by default; -Commit to apply)
    • ODFBGOV-Discovery.ps1 — read-only assessment of OneDrive for Business deployment, KFM, sync-control, storage, and sharing posture
    • ODFBGOV-Report.ps1 — OneDrive for Business governance report (storage, activity, sharing, quota headroom). Read-only
    • ODFBGOV-Set-OffboardingAccess.ps1 — grant a departing user's manager access to their OneDrive and confirm retention (dry-run by default; -Commit to apply)
    • ODFBGOV-Set-Scope.ps1 — scope/config helper: resolve the tenant ID + AD domain GUIDs and emit the exact policy values for silent config, KFM, and sync restriction. Read-only

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
